d: Shobha, a poor woman living with her widower father, falls in love with a gypsy named Mangal. However, other men who wish to be with her make her life difficult.
An honest CBI officer must investigate a series of murders on a train. However, as he makes progress in the case, he finds disturbing leads.
The life of a couple who shifts to Mumbai to prepare for their marriage, undergoes a drastic change when the lady becomes a popular movie star overnight and forgets her purpose amidst the glamour.
Dinanath, a devout Hindu, wishes to get his son Shankar married to Salma, an orphan who lives with them. However, Shankar's childhood sweetheart Neetu returns to his life.
While in Japan to pick up his orphaned nephew, Ashok becomes locked in a romantic misadventure with Asha, a troubled woman who is a master of disguises.
King Vikram arranges his daughter Anuradha's match with his commander's son Pratap. However, trouble strikes when Anuradha is abducted by a bandit Suraj when she goes to attend Pratap's coronation.
A man is falsely accused of his wife's murder and imprisoned. When he sets out to seek revenge, he finds a police officer on his trail who turns out to be his own son.
Ashok and Kumar are best friends who live with Maamaji. Chaos ensues when Maamaji comes up with a series of plans to take Ashok's wealth that accidentally expose them to two sets of lookalikes.
Ramprasad works for Bhavani, who discourages his employees from pursuing any hobbies. Things take a hilarious turn when Bhavani catches Ramprasad at a hockey match, and he lies about having a twin.
Three young women from India, hailing from various states, opt for love instead of adhering to traditional norms, ultimately finding themselves ensnared.
